fields.description: Factor HR draws these as two panels on its Welcome page — Announcements and CEO Speak — and they are the same shape: a title, a body, and a window during which the front page shows it. One doctype with a kind, rather than two doctypes differing in nothing.
fields.label: Kind

fields.description: What the front page shows in the list. It is the whole of what most people will read, so it has to say the thing rather than introduce it.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: Leave empty for the whole group. Set it and only that company's people see it — which is a permission, not a filter, so it is enforced on the server by manna_hr/permissions.py and not by the screen that draws the list.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Off until somebody means it. A notice on everybody's front page is the one thing in this app that is read by people who did not go looking for it, so the default is that a draft stays a draft — Factor HR's own composer has Save as Draft beside Submit for the same reason.
fields.label: Published

fields.description: The first day it appears on the front page. Empty means from now.
fields.label: From Date

fields.description: The last day, inclusive. Empty means it stays until somebody unpublishes it — which is how a front page fills up with a notice about a fire drill in March.
fields.label: To Date

fields.description: Whose name appears under it. For CEO Speak this is the point of the panel; for an ordinary announcement it is usually HR, and Frappe already records who created the record either way.
fields.label: Posted By
